# Generic scrub patterns that public CI runs on every push and pull request:
# secrets and home-folder paths. Format: see .github/scripts/scrub.mjs.
# Test fixtures use the home folder C:/Users/T, which is allowed.

[home-path]
C:\\Users\\(?!T\b)
(?i)C:/Users/(?!T\b)
/Users/(?!T\b)[A-Za-z]
/home/(?!(?:user|t)\b)[a-z]

[secret]
sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}
\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}
github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}
\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b
\brpa_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}
BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY
(?i)bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/=-]{20,}
xox[abprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}

[allow-match]
# Fake keys used by the redaction tests (an alphabet run is never a real key).
(?i)abcdefghijklmnop

[allow-in]
tests/*.test.tsx :: PRIVATE KEY.*MIIEow
